portfolio_settings.bio: Full-Stack Developer passionate about building modern, scalable and creative digital experiences. I enjoy turning ideas into functional applications and exploring technologies across web development, databases, analytics, IoT and AI.
portfolio_settings.about_bio: Full-Stack Developer passionate about building modern, scalable and creative digital experiences. I enjoy turning ideas into functional applications and exploring technologies across web development, databases, analytics, IoT and AI.
portfolio_settings.about_description: With a strong foundation in modern frontend architectures, backend APIs, and cloud infrastructure, I build high-performance web products that deliver exceptional user experiences.

projects.title: AI Workflow Studio
projects.description: Autonomous AI agents orchestration dashboard with real-time streaming workflows, node canvas, and model analytics.
projects.full_description: Comprehensive workflow automation platform built with modern React, TypeScript, and Python AI core. Features real-time multi-agent cooperation, canvas builder, and distributed queue processing.

projects.title: Nexus FinTech Dashboard
projects.description: High-frequency transaction monitor with live analytics, cryptocurrency swaps, and automated risk scoring.
projects.full_description: Ultra-low latency financial analytics dashboard with WebGL charts, multi-currency support, and biometric-grade JWT authentication.

projects.title: CloudMesh IoT Fleet Manager
projects.description: Industrial IoT device management platform monitoring 10,000+ smart edge nodes with anomaly detection.
projects.full_description: Real-time telemetry aggregation platform using MQTT, Node.js microservices, and React glassmorphic telemetry graphs.

experience.description: Leading the development of enterprise SaaS platforms, modernizing legacy architectures into high-performance React and Node.js microservices.
Engineered custom web applications, RESTful API gateways, and interactive analytics dashboards with real-time data streaming.
Crafted responsive, high-fidelity user interfaces, design systems, and client-side performance optimizations for global clients.

education.description: Specialized in Distributed Systems, Database Management Systems, Data Structures, and Software Architecture.
Intensive certification covering microservices, cloud deployments, modern frontend frameworks, and security best practices.

services.title: Full-Stack Web Development
services.description: End-to-end modern web applications built with React, Node.js, and robust relational databases engineered for speed and scale.

services.title: UI/UX Engineering & Design
services.description: Pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces featuring dark aesthetics, glassmorphism, micro-animations, and fluid responsive design.

services.title: Database Architecture & APIs
services.description: High-performance SQL schema design, query optimization, secure RESTful & GraphQL APIs with JWT authentication.

services.title: IoT & Telemetry Dashboards
services.description: Connecting smart devices and sensors to real-time interactive monitoring dashboards with instant anomaly alerts.

services.title: WordPress & Headless CMS
services.description: Custom WordPress theme & plugin development, headless CMS integrations with Next.js/React frontends.

services.title: Performance & Security Optimization
services.description: Audit and acceleration of web apps, Lighthouse 95+ score delivery, caching strategies, and security hardening.
